openAtEnd allows other content only at the end of the list ("Additional content is allowed, but only at the end of the list", ElementDefinition.slicing.rules); HL7 6.10.4 does not report content before a slice.

An invariant that raises an error is not satisfied, as in the HL7 validator's own checkInvariant; tim-9's 'when in (...)' raises one on two 'when' values ("If the left operand has multiple items, an exception is thrown", fhirpath 6.4.2), and short-circuit evaluation cannot be relied on (fhirpath 6.5). HL7 6.10.4 accepts the timing because FHIRPathExpressionFixer.fixExpr replaces this R4 expression with one using when.select($this in ...).allFalse(); gofhir evaluates the published expression.
